# functions
```{r}
call_model <- function(df, outcome_name, top_genes, covars, adjustment=NULL, model_type) {
  results <- data.frame(gene = character(), beta = numeric(), ci_lower = numeric(), ci_upper = numeric(), beta_ci = character(), pval = numeric(), stringsAsFactors = FALSE)

  for (gene in top_genes) {
    gene <- ifelse(grepl("\\|", gene), paste0("`", gene, "`"), gene)

    formula_components <- c(gene, covars, adjustment)
    formula_str <- paste0(outcome_name, " ~ ", paste0(formula_components, collapse = " + "))
    
    tryCatch({
      if (model_type == "nb") {
        model <- glm.nb(as.formula(formula_str), data = df)
      } else if (model_type == "binomial") {
        model <- glm(as.formula(formula_str), data = df, family = binomial())
      }
        else if (model_type == "lm") {
        model <- lm(as.formula(formula_str), data = df)
      }
  

    beta <- coef(model)[gene]
    ci <- confint(model, gene, level = 0.95)
    beta_ci <- sprintf("%.3f (%.3f, %.3f)", beta, ci[1], ci[2])
    pval <- summary(model)$coefficients[gene, 4]
    results <- rbind(results, data.frame(gene = gene, beta = beta, ci_lower = ci[1], ci_upper = ci[2], beta_ci = beta_ci, pval = pval))
    }, error = function(e) {
      message(sprintf("Skipping gene %s due to error: %s", gene, e$message))
    })
  }
  return(results)
}
```

```{r}
get_ntile_summary <- function(df, outcome_name, score, covars, adjustment=NULL, model_type=NULL, ntile) {
  # create ntile column for score
  df <- df %>%
    mutate(score_ntile = ntile(.data[[score]], ntile))
 
  ntile_results <- data.frame(ntile = numeric(),
                             OR = numeric(),
                             OR_CI_lower = numeric(),
                             OR_CI_upper = numeric(), 
                             beta = numeric(),
                             beta_ci_lower = numeric(),
                             beta_ci_upper = numeric(),
                             P = numeric(),
                             N = numeric(),
                             Mean = numeric(),
                             Sd = numeric())
                              
  for (cur_ntile in 1:ntile) {
    df$cur_ntile <- ifelse(df$score_ntile == 1, 0, ifelse(df$score_ntile == cur_ntile, 1, NA))
    if (cur_ntile == 1) {
      ntile_results <- rbind(ntile_results,
                                data.frame(ntile = cur_ntile,
                                           OR = 1,
                                           CI_lower = NA,
                                           CI_upper = NA,
                                           beta = 0,
                                           beta_ci_lower = NA,
                                           beta_ci_upper = NA,
                                           P = NA,
                                           N = sum(df$score_ntile == 1, na.rm = TRUE),
                                           Mean = mean(df[df$score_ntile == 1, score], na.rm = TRUE),
                                           Sd = sd(df[df$score_ntile == 1, score], na.rm = TRUE)))
    } else {
      model_table <- call_model(df[!is.na(df$cur_ntile), ], outcome_name, top_genes = "cur_ntile", covars = covars, adjustment = adjustment, model_type = model_type)

      ntile_results <- rbind(ntile_results,
                                data.frame(ntile = cur_ntile,
                                           OR = exp(model_table$beta),
                                           CI_lower = exp(model_table$ci_lower),
                                           CI_upper = exp(model_table$ci_upper),
                                           beta = model_table$beta,
                                           beta_ci_lower = model_table$ci_lower,
                                           beta_ci_upper = model_table$ci_upper,
                                           P = model_table$pval,
                                           N = sum(df$cur_ntile == 1, na.rm = TRUE),
                                           Mean = mean(df[df$cur_ntile == 1, score], na.rm = TRUE),
                                           Sd = sd(df[df$cur_ntile == 1, score], na.rm = TRUE)))
    }
  }
  
  return(ntile_results)
}

```

```{r}

call_coxph <- function(df, time, event, predictor, adjustment_vars) {
  
  surv_obj <- Surv(time = df[[time]], event = df[[event]])
  
  formula_components <- c(predictor, adjustment_vars)
  formula <- as.formula(paste0("surv_obj ~ ", paste(formula_components, collapse = " + ")))
  
  model <- coxph(formula, data = df)
  
  ph_test <- cox.zph(model)

  pred <- predict(model, type = "risk")
  c_stat <- summary(model)$concordance["C"]
  c_stat_se <- summary(model)$concordance["se(C)"]

  summ <- summary(model)$coefficients
  cis <- confint(model)
  
  beta <- summ[predictor, "coef"]
  se <- summ[predictor, "se(coef)"]
  pval <- summ[predictor, "Pr(>|z|)"]
  ci <- cis[predictor, ]
    
  hr <- exp(beta)
  hr_ci <- sprintf("%.3f (%.3f, %.3f)", hr, exp(ci[1]), exp(ci[2]))
    
  ph_pval <- if (predictor %in% rownames(ph_test$table)) ph_test$table[predictor, "p"] else NA
    
  result_df <- data.frame(predictor = predictor, hr = hr, 
             ci_lower = exp(ci[1]), ci_upper = exp(ci[2]), 
             hr_ci = hr_ci, se = se, pval = pval, n_samples = model$n, 
             n_events = summary(model)$nevent,
             ph_pval = ph_pval, c_stat = c_stat, c_stat_se = c_stat_se)

  return(list(result=result_df, ph_test=ph_test, model=model))
}
```

```{r}
common_genes <- intersect(
  module_weights_df$Gene_Name,
  rownames(exprMat2)

weight_vec <- module_weights_df %>%
  filter(Gene_Name %in% common_genes) %>%
  arrange(match(Gene_Name, common_genes)) %>%
  pull(COPDGene_reweighted)

expr_sub_t <- as.data.frame(t(expr_sub))
expr_sub_t$IID <- rownames(expr_sub_t)

age_w <- formula_table$COPDGene_reweighted[formula_table$Predictor == "age"]
sex_w <- formula_table$COPDGene_reweighted[formula_table$Predictor == "sex"]
intercept_w <- formula_table$COPDGene_reweighted[formula_table$Predictor == "intercept"]

scores <- as.vector(as.matrix(df[, common_genes]) %*% weight_vec) +
  age_w * df$age +
  sex_w * df$gender +

summary(scores)
sd(scores)
cat("Q4 nerd score cutoff before scaling:", q4_cutoff)

df$nerd_score <- scale(scores)
```

```{r}
formula_components <- c("nerd_score", "Exacerbation_Frequency", "ATS_PackYears", "SmokCigNow", "offset(log(days_followed/365))")
formula_str <- paste0("has_exacerbation ~ ", paste0(formula_components, collapse = " + "))
model_nerd_exac_py_smk <- glm(as.formula(formula_str), data = df, family = binomial())

beta_all <- coef(model_nerd_exac_py_smk)
ci_all <- confint(model_nerd_exac_py_smk, level = 0.95)
pval_all <- summary(model_nerd_exac_py_smk)$coefficients[, 4]

nerd_exac_py_smk_table <- data.frame(
  predictor = names(beta_all),
  beta = beta_all,
  ci_lower = ci_all[, 1],
  ci_upper = ci_all[, 2],
  pval = pval_all,
  row.names = NULL) %>%
  mutate(or = exp(beta), ci_lower = exp(ci_lower), ci_upper = exp(ci_upper), or_ci = sprintf("%.2f (%.2f, %.2f)", or, ci_lower, ci_upper)) %>%
  mutate(pval = ifelse(pval < 0.001, "<.001",
                ifelse(pval < 0.01, sub("^0", "", sprintf("%.3f", pval)),
                                    sub("^0", "", sprintf("%.2f", pval))))) %>%
  filter(!predictor %in% c("(Intercept)")) %>%
  mutate(predictor = c("NERD score", "Prior exacerbation", "Pack years", "Current smoking")) %>%
  dplyr::select(predictor, or_ci, pval)

write.table(nerd_exac_py_smk_table, "../data/multivariable_model_sumtab_eclipse_adj_smk_status.txt", row.names = F, quote = F, sep = "\t")
```

## AUC
```{r message=FALSE, warning=FALSE}
# nerd only
model_nerd <- glm(has_exacerbation ~ nerd_score + offset(log(days_followed/365)), 
                          data = df, family = binomial())
df$pred_prob_nerd <- predict(model_nerd, type = "response")
roc_nerd <- roc(response  = df$has_exacerbation, predictor = df$pred_prob_nerd)

# prior exac only

                       data = df, family = binomial())
df$pred_prob_exac <- predict(model_exac, type = "response")
roc_exac <- roc(response  = df$has_exacerbation, predictor = df$pred_prob_exac)

# prior exac and nerd score
model_nerd_exac <- glm(has_exacerbation ~ Exacerbation_Frequency + nerd_score + offset(log(days_followed/365)), 
                          data = df, family = binomial())
df$pred_prob_nerd_exac <- predict(model_nerd_exac, type = "response")
roc_nerd_exac <- roc(response  = df$has_exacerbation, predictor = df$pred_prob_nerd_exac)
```

```{r}
auc_diff_row <- function(roc_new, roc_ref) {
  d <- as.numeric(auc(roc_new) - auc(roc_ref))
  se <- sqrt(var(roc_new, method = "delong") + var(roc_ref, method = "delong") -
               2 * cov(roc_new, roc_ref, method = "delong"))
  p <- roc.test(roc_new, roc_ref, method = "delong")$p.value
  c(diff = d, lo = d - 1.96 * se, hi = d + 1.96 * se, p = p)
}
fmt_num <- function(x) sprintf("%.3f", x)
fmt_auc <- function(roc_obj) {
  ci <- as.numeric(ci.auc(roc_obj))
  sprintf("%.3f (%.3f, %.3f)", ci[2], ci[1], ci[3])
}
make_auc_table <- function(rows) {
  do.call(rbind, lapply(names(rows), function(lbl) {
    r <- rows[[lbl]]
    if (is.null(r$ref)) {
      data.frame(Model = lbl, `AUC (95% CI)` = fmt_auc(r$roc),
                 `Difference vs reference (95% CI)` = "Reference",
                 `P value` = "NA", check.names = FALSE)
    } else {
      s <- auc_diff_row(r$roc, r$ref)
      data.frame(Model = lbl, `AUC (95% CI)` = fmt_auc(r$roc),
                 `Difference vs reference (95% CI)` =
                   sprintf("%s (%s, %s)", fmt_num(s["diff"]), fmt_num(s["lo"]), fmt_num(s["hi"])),
                 `P value` = round(s["p"], 3), check.names = FALSE)
    }
  }))
}

auc_table <- make_auc_table(list(
  "Prior exacerbation alone" = list(roc = roc_exac),
  "Prior exacerbation and NERD score" = list(roc = roc_nerd_exac, ref = roc_exac)
))

auc_table
write.table(auc_table, "../data/auc_diff_table_ECLIPSE.txt", sep = "\t", row.names = FALSE, quote = FALSE)
```

### PPV NPV
```{r}
df$pred_pos <- df$score_ntile == 4
ppv_npv <- df %>%
  summarise(
    TP = sum(pred_pos & has_exacerbation == 1, na.rm = TRUE),
    FP = sum(pred_pos & has_exacerbation == 0, na.rm = TRUE),
    FN = sum(!pred_pos & has_exacerbation == 1, na.rm = TRUE),
    TN = sum(!pred_pos & has_exacerbation == 0, na.rm = TRUE),
    sens = TP / (TP + FN),
    spec = TN / (TN + FP),
    prev = mean(has_exacerbation == 1, na.rm = TRUE),  
    PPV = (prev * sens) / ((prev * sens) + ((1 - prev) * (1 - spec))),
    NPV = ((1 - prev) * spec) / (((1 - prev) * spec) + (prev * (1 - sens))))

# ChanRev39
ppv_npv
write.table(ppv_npv, "../data/ppv_npv_sumtab_ec.txt", row.names = F, quote = F, sep = "\t")
```

```{r}
nerd_exac_py_smk_cox <- call_coxph(df, time = "time_to_first_exac", event = "lfu_has_exac", predictor = "nerd_score", 
                                 adjustment_vars = c("Exacerbation_Frequency", "ATS_PackYears", "SmokCigNow"))

nerd_exac_py_smk_cox_out <- summary(nerd_exac_py_smk_cox$model)$coefficients
nerd_exac_py_smk_cox_ci <- confint(nerd_exac_py_smk_cox$model)
nerd_exac_py_smk_cox_sumtab <- data.frame(
  predictor = rownames(nerd_exac_py_smk_cox_out),
  hr = exp(nerd_exac_py_smk_cox_out[, "coef"]),
  ci_lower = exp(nerd_exac_py_smk_cox_ci[, 1]),
  ci_upper = exp(nerd_exac_py_smk_cox_ci[, 2]),
  cox_hr_ci_ECLIPSE = sprintf("%.2f (%.2f, %.2f)", exp(nerd_exac_py_smk_cox_out[, "coef"]), exp(nerd_exac_py_smk_cox_ci[, 1]), exp(nerd_exac_py_smk_cox_ci[, 2])),
  cox_pval_ECLIPSE = nerd_exac_py_smk_cox_out[, "Pr(>|z|)"],
  row.names = NULL
) %>%
  mutate(cox_pval_ECLIPSE = ifelse(cox_pval_ECLIPSE < 0.001, "<.001",
                ifelse(cox_pval_ECLIPSE < 0.01, sub("^0", "", sprintf("%.3f", cox_pval_ECLIPSE)),
                                    sub("^0", "", sprintf("%.2f", cox_pval_ECLIPSE))))) %>%
  mutate(predictor = c("NERD score", "Prior exacerbation", "Pack years", "Current smoking")) %>%
  dplyr::select(predictor, cox_hr_ci_ECLIPSE, cox_pval_ECLIPSE)
DT::datatable(nerd_exac_py_smk_cox_sumtab)

write.table(nerd_exac_py_smk_cox_sumtab, "../data/survival_sumtab_has_exac_all_vars_cox_ph_EC.txt", row.names = F, quote = F, sep = "\t")
```

## km
```{r fig.height=6, fig.width=4.5}
km_plot_df <- df %>%
  dplyr::select(time_to_first_exac, lfu_has_exac, nerd_score, days_followed) %>%
  mutate(
    nerd_quartile = cut(nerd_score, 
                        breaks = quantile(nerd_score, probs = seq(0, 1, 0.25), na.rm = TRUE),
                        include.lowest = TRUE, labels = c("Q1", "Q2", "Q3", "Q4")))

km_plot_df_Q1_Q4 <- km_plot_df %>% 
  filter(nerd_quartile %in% c("Q1", "Q4")) %>%
  mutate(nerd_quartile = droplevels(nerd_quartile))

# coin for Fleming-Harrington test
# pvalue for Q1 vs Q4
fh_test <- logrank_test(Surv(time_to_first_exac, lfu_has_exac) ~ nerd_quartile, data = km_plot_df_Q1_Q4, type = "Fleming-Harrington", rho = 0, gamma = 1)

km_fit_all <- survfit(
  Surv(time_to_first_exac, lfu_has_exac) ~ nerd_quartile,
  data = km_plot_df
)

time_by_q <- km_plot_df %>%
  group_by(nerd_quartile) %>%
  summarise(
    time_to_event_iqr = sprintf("%.0f [%.0f, %.0f]", median(time_to_first_exac, na.rm = TRUE), 
                        quantile(time_to_first_exac, 0.25, na.rm = TRUE), 
                        quantile(time_to_first_exac, 0.75, na.rm = TRUE)),
    time_followed_iqr = sprintf("%.0f [%.0f, %.0f]", median(days_followed, na.rm = TRUE), 
                        quantile(days_followed, 0.25, na.rm = TRUE), 
                        quantile(days_followed, 0.75, na.rm = TRUE))) %>%
  mutate(cohort = "ECLIPSE") %>%
  relocate(cohort)

p <- ggsurvplot(
  km_fit_all,
  data = km_plot_df,
  censor = TRUE,
  xlab = "Days",
  ylab = "Exacerbation-Free Survival",
  title = "ECLIPSE",
  legend.title = "NERD Quartile",
  legend.labs = c("Q1", "Q2", "Q3", "Q4"),
  risk.table = TRUE,
  risk.table.title = "Number Event-Free",
  tables.theme = theme_survminer() + 
    theme(plot.title = element_text(size = 12)),
  palette = c("#FFAA00", "#FF6600", "#CC0000", "#660000")
)

p$plot <- p$plot +
  annotate("text", x = 50, y = 0.1, hjust = 0, label = sprintf("p(Q1 vs. Q4) = %.3f", pvalue(fh_test)), size = 5)

print(p)
png("../figures_final/kaplan_meier_all_q_eclipse.png", width = 4.5, height = 6, units = "in", res = 600)
print(p)
dev.off()
cairo_ps("../figures_final/kaplan_meier_all_q_eclipse.eps", width = 4.5, height = 6)
print(p)
dev.off()
```

# stratified on prior exacerbation
## AUC compare
```{r}
df_zero_exac <- df %>% filter(Exacerbation_Frequency == 0)
df_prior_exac <- df %>% filter(Exacerbation_Frequency > 0)

# nerd only
formula_str <- "has_exacerbation ~ nerd_score + offset(log(days_followed/365))"
model_nerd_exac1 <- glm(as.formula(formula_str), data = df_prior_exac, family = binomial())
model_nerd_exac0 <- glm(as.formula(formula_str), data = df_zero_exac, family = binomial())
roc_nerd_exac1 <- roc(df_prior_exac$has_exacerbation, predict(model_nerd_exac1, type = "response"))
roc_nerd_exac0 <- roc(df_zero_exac$has_exacerbation, predict(model_nerd_exac0, type = "response"))
```

```{r}
models <- c("NERD score no prior exacerbation", "NERD score with prior exacerbation")
rocs <- list(roc_nerd_exac0, roc_nerd_exac1)

auc_df <- data.frame(model = models, auc = sapply(rocs, auc))

ci_mat <- t(sapply(rocs, ci.auc))
auc_df$ci_low  <- ci_mat[,1]
auc_df$ci_high <- ci_mat[,3]

auc_df$model <- factor(auc_df$model, levels = models)
auc_df

write.table(auc_df, "../data/auc_df_nerd_vs_smk_prior_exac_strat_eclipse.txt", quote = F, row.names = F, sep = "\t")
```
